message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine criminal charge(s) under Chinese law. Facts: Using stolen Apple account info to remotely lock others' Apple devices, set to lost mode or erase, making them unusable, then extorting unlock fees. This is a form of "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪"? Or "非法侵入计算机信息系统罪"? Also "敲诈勒索罪" (extortion). The act of remotely locking devices via stolen credentials is unauthorized access to computer information system, i.e., "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪" (illegal acquisition of computer information system data) or "非法控制计算机信息系统罪". Chinese Criminal Law article 285 (formerly 286) deals with illegal intrusion. Also extortion: demanding money by threatening to continue lock. So likely two crimes: "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪" and "敲诈勒索罪". However the amount is small (1150 yuan). For extortion, threshold for criminal liability is 2000 yuan? Actually Chinese law: extortion (敲诈勒索罪) requires amount of 2000 yuan or more, but also can be prosecuted if circumstances are serious. 1150 is below threshold, may be considered "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪" (which doesn't have monetary threshold). Also could be "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪" (Article 285) or "非法控制计算机信息系统罪". The act: using stolen Apple account to lock devices, i.e., unauthorized control of computer information system. That is "非法控制计算机信息系统罪". The law: Article 285 (2) says: "非法获取计算机信息系统数据、非法控制计算机信息系统的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处或者单处罚金。" So charge: "非法控制计算机信息系统罪". Also extortion maybe not meet threshold. So answer likely single crime: "非法控制计算机信息系统罪". Provide format.

Thus final answer: [罪名]非法控制计算机信息系统罪<eoa>
